item.title: Central‐Atom‐Differentiated Solvent Chemistry Enables Anion‐Reinforced Solvation for Ultra‐Long Cycling Ah‐Level Sodium‐Ion Pouch Cells
item.description:

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Introducing ethylene sulfite into carbonate electrolytes differentiates solvent central-atom chemistry (sulfur vs. carbon), rebalancing solvent-anion competition to reinforce PF₆⁻ in Na⁺ solvation. This lowers desolvation barriers and forms inorganic-rich interphases on both electrodes, enabling a 2.34 Ah pouch cell to retain 81.29% capacity after 3500 cycles and operate from −20°C to 50°C.
🏷 sodium-ion battery · ethylene sulfite · solvation structure · pouch cell · interphase

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work reframes PC co-intercalation in graphite as a system-level kinetic competition, not a fixed EC–PC disparity. It introduces the "lowest achievable potential" descriptor linking solvation, interphase, and operating conditions. Significance: a unified kinetic framework enabling rational electrolyte, binder, and graphite design to suppress solvent co-intercalation and stabilize graphite anodes.

item.title: Bilayer Hydrogel Electrolytes Regulate Electric‐Field‐Induced Deformation in Zinc–Sodium Hybrid Batteries
item.description:
این مقاله تغییرشکل القایی میدان الکتریکی در الکترولیت هیدروژل PAM را بررسی و با ساخت الکترولیت دولایه PAM/PANa، پایداری فصل مشترک و ظرفیت باتری هیبریدی روی-سدیم را بهبود می‌بخشد.
Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work reveals electric-field-induced deformation in PAM hydrogel electrolytes via Zn–O/Zn–N adhesion, causing interfacial separation and reduced battery life. A bilayer electrolyte coupling PAM with PANa counteracts contraction, maintains contact, and boosts zinc-sodium hybrid battery performance: 117 mAh g⁻¹ initial capacity (20% higher) and 81.6% retention after 1000 cycles.
🏷 hydrogel electrolyte · zinc-sodium battery · electric-field deformation · bilayer electrolyte · interfacial contact
